outcome: Positive predictive value (PPV) of NIPS for T21
Negative predictive value (NPV) of NIPS for T21
cohort: 25,798 pregnant women who underwent NIPS in Russia from January 2013 to December 2018
finding: Non-invasive prenatal screening (NIPS) demonstrated high sensitivity (99.25%), specificity (99.96%), positive predictive value (98.7%), and negative predictive value (99.98%) for detecting trisomy 21 (T21) in this cohort.
gest_age: First trimester (mentioned in context of fetal fraction of free DNA)
